assertions.name: c_4_at_silver_is_minus_49_32
assertions.source: c_4 = c_3·b⁴ with b² = 7/8 at silver → -49/32 (Pell-Lucas-clean)

assertions.name: c_7_at_silver_is_minus_8
assertions.source: c_7 = c_3³ is constant; clean integer

description: Silver-ratio (q = 1 + √2) benchmark for c_k closed forms. At silver ratio: h = 2 (β-decay null), b² = 7/8 exactly, q-integers reduce to Pell-Lucas. Tests whether c_k closed forms evaluate to Pell-Lucas-clean rationals at the silver ratio — categorical correctness criterion.

data.outlier_finding: c_5 = -11/8 at silver ratio; 11 is not Pell-Lucas. This flags the empirical `-(b² + 1/2)` closed form as categorically suspect. Other c_k (c_3, c_4, c_6, c_7) pass the silver-ratio Pell-Lucas test.
